action.expression: (async () => { const stage = document.querySelector('[data-vqa=\"graph-stage\"]'); const zoomIn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label=\"拡大\"]'); const zoomOut = document.querySelector('button[aria-label=\"縮小\"]'); if (!stage || !zoomIn || !zoomOut) throw new Error('implementation zoom controls not found'); let clicks = 0; const scale = () => Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(stage).getPropertyValue('--stage-zoom')) || 1; if (scale() > 1.5) { zoomOut.click(); clicks += 1; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 180)); } while (stage.dataset.vqaLod !== 'implementation' && clicks < 6) { zoomIn.click(); clicks += 1; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 120)); } return { clicked: 'zoom-implementation', clicks, lod: stage.dataset.vqaLod, scale: scale() }; })()
